security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, if the H extension is NOT implemented but mnstatus CSR still defines MNPV as a writable/readable field (non-WARL-zero), or conversely, if the H extension IS implemented but MNPV is absent from the CSR bit layout, causing the RNMI trap handler to fail to capture the virtualization mode (V=1 vs V=0) of the interrupted context
security_spec.summary: mnstatus.MNPV must be conditionally implemented based on H extension presence; unconditional inclusion causes RNMI trap handler to save/restore bogus virtualization state, breaking guest/host isolation on NMI return
